# @stackline/wcwidth@1.0.0 on Alexandro.Net

- Canonical documentation: https://alexandro.net/docs/vanilla/wcwidth/
- Source: https://github.com/alexandroit/stackline-wcwidth
- Upstream compatibility baseline: wcwidth@1.0.1
- Runtime: Node.js 18 or newer and modern browser bundlers
- Module formats: callable CommonJS and native ESM default and named exports
- Types: TypeScript 3.9-compatible CommonJS and conditional modern declarations
- Unicode model: checksum-pinned Unicode 17.0.0 extended grapheme clusters
- Production closure: one root node and zero dependencies
- License: MIT

Identity-preserving npm alias:

wcwidth@npm:@stackline/wcwidth@1.0.0

The package preserves the historical callable function and config object
semantics while correcting terminal widths with current Unicode data. Combining
text may be zero-width within a cluster; East Asian Wide and Fullwidth values
use two columns; flags, keycaps, presentation sequences, and qualifying emoji
ZWJ sequences use two columns per grapheme cluster.
